Day 2
Lecture 1: setting up an environment. 
Pixi [Quarto] (https://pixi.prefix.dev/latest/workspace/environment/)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wget -qO- https://pixi.sh/install.sh | sh
```
:::


Everytime you need to initiate a pixi environment in the same folder, you're working in


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pixi init name_pixi_training -c conda-forge -c bioconda
```
:::


There will be a pixi.toml file. It would look a little like this


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
1[workspace]
2channels = ["conda-forge", "bioconda"]
3name = "amrei_pixi_training"
4platforms = ["linux-64"]
version = "0.1.0"

5[tasks]

6[dependencies]
```
:::
